name: Ubaidullah Khan
contribution: The 4th Shaybanid Khan of Bukhara, who ruled between 1534 and 1539.

checks.lead: Ubaidullah Khan (Chagatai/Persian: عبیدالله خان; 1487–1539), also Ubaid Khan, was the 4th Shaybanid Khan of Bukhara, who ruled between 1534 and 1539. He was the son of Mahmud and nephew of Muhammad Shaybani, founder of the Shaybanid dynasty.
